newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average fell 19.38 points to 6,528.41 on Tuesday after rebounding from a big sell-off as investors took profits after the market's record-breaking rally.

* Indonesia's current account deficit widened to $4.521 billion in the first half of fiscal 1996/97 (April-March) from $3.749 billion in the same period last year, Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said.
* Four large state-owned banks were reported to have cut their deposit rates by 0.5 to one percent.
* The Jakarta composite index fell 2.01 points, or 0.32 percent, to close at 626.23 points on Tuesday after reaching a high of 631.64 points in early trade.
* Brokers said the market was likely to be weak on Wednesday due to expected profit-taking in newly-listed BNI and other big-capitalised stocks.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,344.25/44.50 in early trading against the opening of 2,344.00/45.00.

* Astra International on comments by five business tycoons together holding more than 50 percent of the company that they did not have any plans yet to change the automobile conglomerate's management and business lines.
* Toll road operator Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada (CMNP) on reports that four prospective investors had withdrawn from a CMNP-led consortium which planned to build a toll road in East Java.
* Newly-listed Bank BNI on expected profit-taking following previous rises.
* Bank Ficorinvest on announcement of stock split to 500 rupiah per share from 1,000 rupiah.
